changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Where the money of a lot or contribution came from (issue #508). Only a PURCHASE is paid from the wallet's cash or with new money; a REINVESTMENT lot is paid by the exit it pairs with, and a MOVE lot carries cost already invested in another wallet.

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Tags the lots and contributions written before the column existed. A reinvestment and the lot it lands, and a partial move and the lot it writes on the destination, are inserted in one transaction, so their created_at, the transaction's now(), is identical. A merge keeps the original lots, whose created_at never matches, so they stay purchases of the wallet that owns them today.

changeSet.author: ${claude}
${claude}
changeSet.comment: A wallet's cash is replayed from its events rather than stored, so a backdated entry reshapes every later balance and funding split. A purchase takes what the balance holds up to its own amount and the rest is new money; transfers out and bank withdrawals take their whole amount, so a replay that ends below zero is what the service refuses.

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW finances.wallet_cash AS SELECT wallets.id AS wallet_id, COALESCE(( SELECT replay.balance FROM finances.wallet_cash_replay(wallets.id) AS replay ORDER BY replay.sequence DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS cash FROM finances.wallets;

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Cash a wallet holds the moment the feature ships came from exits recorded before anyone could say where their money went, so it is flagged for the reconciliation page.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE finances.wallets SET cash_reconciled = FALSE FROM finances.wallet_cash WHERE wallet_cash.wallet_id = wallets.id AND wallet_cash.cash > 0;
